Dear Mr. Reese,

Re: Account reference: ACC-501126

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have stated that you made timely payments, but the original creditor, Platinum Card Services, charged off the account on August 2, 2022. The last payment received from you was on July 30, 2024. The current balance on the account is $3,268.55.

We understand that you are disputing the debt based on hardship. However, we must inform you that, under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to validate the debt only if you dispute the debt in writing and the debt is not subject to a pending bankruptcy action. You have not requested validation, and we have no information that a bankruptcy action is pending.

We will investigate your claim of making timely payments and will review the account history. If our investigation confirms that you made timely payments, we will work with the original creditor to determine the next steps to resolve the account.

Please note that, under Alabama law, a debt collector must provide a written notice of the debt and a statement of the amount of the debt, including the name of the creditor, the amount of the debt, and a statement that unless the consumer disputes the validity of the debt, the debt collector will assume the debt to be valid. We have provided this information to you.

You have the right to further dispute the debt if you believe it is inaccurate or invalid. If you wish to dispute the debt further, please respond in writing to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
